title.es: El de cuando Jaime decide quedarse
title.en: The One Where Jaime Decides to Stay

description.es: Marta visita a Fina, pero no es capaz de decirle que Jaime se queda. Aunque Marta les deja claro tanto a Jaime como a Damián que no quiere que Jaime se quede, a ninguno de los dos le importa, e insisten en que hay que salvar el matrimonio. Jaime le dice a Marta que ha encontrado trabajo en un hospital de Madrid.
description.en: Marta visits Fina but cannot bring herself to tell her that Jaime is staying. Even though Marta makes it clear to both Jaime and Damián that she does not want Jaime to stay, neither of them cares, and they insist that the marriage must be saved. Jaime tells Marta that he has found a job at a hospital in Madrid.
